title: UcasConfirmationOutboundV1
description: Outbound UCAS confirmation payload generated by POST /api/v1/regulatory/ucas/confirmations/generate. Contains one confirmation record per pending enrolment, withdrawal, or deferral event for the given UCAS cycle. The payload is transmitted to UCAS via the UCAS web link API or equivalent channel.

cycle.description: UCAS cycle year this batch applies to, e.g. '2025'.

confirmations.description: Ordered list of confirmation records. May be empty if no pending confirmations exist for the cycle.

triggerId.description: Internal downstream trigger ID. Idempotency key: re-transmitting the same triggerId to UCAS must be treated as a no-op.

enrolmentId.description: SRS enrolment UUID that drove this confirmation.

ucasPersonalId.description: UCAS Personal ID of the applicant.

confirmationType.description: Type of confirmation to send to UCAS. 'enrolled' = enrolment confirmed; 'withdrawn' = applicant withdrew or no-show; 'deferred' = start deferred to next cycle.

confirmedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the confirmation event occurred in SRS.
